description: First real submissions of the cycle plus a live crawl. Front A submitted moves off 0 for the first time since 18/06: Thyssen Ads (r184) submitted 16/09 and Brand Bolt (r182) submitted 17/09, both confirmed by Dario. Also records the 17/09 crawl, which was the first one with actual web access - WebSearch became available where it had been blocked on 15/09, so roles were discovered live rather than mined from the existing pool. WebFetch is still blocked by the egress proxy, so postings could not be opened and employers still cannot be verified from this session. KNOWN GAP: the bridge has no 'applied.append' op, so the two APPLIED rows cannot be written by this batch. They are listed in the description of the activity rows below and must be added by hand or by extending the bridge.

rows.outcome: SUBMITTED, confirmed by Dario. First Front A submission of the cycle - APPLIED had been static at 21 rows since 18/06 and submitted had been 0.
rows.nextStep: Add the APPLIED row by hand: Date found, Job title 'Google Ads Specialist', Company 'Thyssen Ads', STATUS 'Submitted 16/09/2026'. The bridge has no applied.append op.
rows.notes: Ten screening answers were written for this form and saved as a reusable bank: Drive doc 'ADX - BANKA ODGOVORA za obrasce (Google Ads)'. Same questions recur on the other ATS forms in the pool.

rows.target: Brand Bolt - Senior Google Media Buyer
rows.action: Submit application through the employer's Teamtailor form: motivation letter with two anonymized account cases, master CV, and the form's own screening fields including personally managed monthly spend
rows.outcome: SUBMITTED, confirmed by Dario. Second Front A submission of the cycle.
rows.nextStep: Add the APPLIED row by hand: Job title 'Senior Google Media Buyer', Company 'Brand Bolt', STATUS 'Submitted 17/09/2026'.
rows.notes: Spend field answered 2700000 USD, the strict reading of 'personally managed and optimized' (EUR 2.5M hands-on). The EUR 7.8M regional figure was placed in the free-text examples field, labelled as regional responsibility rather than hands-on, so the two cannot be read as the same claim. Beauty/skincare/supplements question answered honestly as no, with policy-constrained category experience offered as the transferable ground.

rows.target: Live crawl across Ashby, Greenhouse, Lever, Teamtailor, Workable, Recruitee, Dynamite Jobs and the Croatian market
rows.action: Run the first crawl of the project with live web access, deduplicate against the 166 companies already in Found positions and APPLIED, and rank what is new
rows.outcome: WebSearch is available for the first time - it was refused at CONNECT on 15/09. WebFetch remains blocked by the egress proxy, so postings could not be opened and no employer could be verified. Roughly 20 net-new roles found; 3 packaged (Whatnot, Impact Brands, Adcubator), the rest listed for selection. Monks excluded on geography: US states only plus a return-to-office policy.
rows.nextStep: Dario picks by number from the candidate list. Employer verification still cannot be done from this session.
rows.notes: The 15/09 source audit finding still holds and is now actionable: the pipeline had inherited the bias of two boards. This crawl deliberately queried ATS platforms directly rather than aggregators.

rows.Work mode / Location: Remote Europe / London referenced - confirm Croatia eligibility
rows.Compensation: GBP 120,000-150,000 per year plus benefits and equity
rows.Availability status: Found via live search 17/09; posting not opened - WebFetch blocked; employer NOT verified
rows.Priority: A - Primary / geo eligibility to confirm
rows.Work description: Identify, test and scale emerging paid media channels for European expansion. Requires 7+ years, 3+ in European markets, and a hands-on track record managing $1M+/month with proven payback. The $1M+/month gate is the differentiator: EUR 2.5M hands-on (~$2.7M) clears it 2.7x. Honest gap: the role centres on emerging channels beyond the established ones, while the record is concentrated in Google and paid search. Compensation sits above the EUR 100,000 reference.

rows.Availability status: Found via live search 17/09; posting not opened - WebFetch blocked; employer NOT verified
rows.Priority: A - Primary / comp band to confirm
rows.Work description: Google Ads buying for a portfolio of 7+ health and wellness supplement brands (PureHealth Research, Nation Health MD, Pureance, Trumeta, PetMade, VitalPeak, Nature's Blast). Directly answers the supplements gap the Brand Bolt form exposed: supplements sit under the same strict platform policy as the sensitive-category retail work in the record, which is the transferable edge. Fully remote with no geography constraint. Flag: title is Media Buyer rather than senior, so the band may sit below the EUR 100,000 reference - establish it early.

rows.Compensation: Listed as $16k-$26k per year - VERIFY, implausibly low for a senior seat
rows.Availability status: Found via live search 17/09; posting not opened - WebFetch blocked; employer NOT verified
rows.Priority: B - Conditional / compensation is the blocker, not the fit
rows.Work description: Full-stack Google buyer, core Search and Shopping at scale. Agency states nine figures in annual ad spend across 180+ ecommerce DTC brands, direct relationships with Google product teams, alpha and beta access, weekly mentoring from the founder. On content this is the closest match in the whole pool to the verified record. The posted band of $16k-$26k per year is the problem: it is roughly a quarter of the EUR 100,000 reference and suggests hiring from low-cost regions. Fit score reflects the work; the priority reflects the money. Establish compensation before investing interview time.

ops.why: Three net-new roles worth packaging, deduplicated against the 166 companies already present in Found positions and APPLIED. Column Y (Actions) is protected and deliberately not written. Availability status records honestly that the posting was never opened, because WebFetch is blocked - the detail comes from search results, not from the employer's page.
